meta.title: PCB — You Don't Need to Know Coding to Build Your Own Software
meta.desc: PCB is an AI coding tool for people who have little or no coding experience. Tell the AI what you want to make, and build it on your own computer.
hero.title: You Don't Need to Know Coding to Build Your Own Software.
hero.tagline: Start with an idea. Let AI help you turn it into a real product.
hero.lead: PCB is an AI coding tool for people who have little or no coding experience.
hero.lead2: Just tell the AI what you want to make, using everyday language. It can help you explore your idea, make a plan, write code and build your product on your own computer.
hero.lead3: You don't need to learn programming before you get started.
hero.alt: One sentence builds a Candy Crush-style match-3: PCB shows a plan, then writes the files, and you play in the same window
hero.visual.title: One sentence. One Candy Crush-style game.
hero.visual.caption: Choose a project and tell PCB: "Build me a match-3 game like Candy Crush." PCB shows you a plan first. Once you approve it, the AI starts writing and changing files. When the work is done, you can play the game in the same window.
work.title: Start with an Idea. Build It Step by Step.
work.lead: PCB brings AI chat, task planning and real work on your computer into one place. This makes building software with AI easier to understand and control.
work.lead2: PCB does not build a second AI agent. It uses Oh My Pi (OMP) to do the actual AI work. PCB gives you a simple interface and helps you manage and check each step.
work.chat.sub: Tell AI what you want to make.
work.chat.d: Talk to AI in your own words.
work.chat.ex1: I want to make a budgeting app.
work.chat.ex2: I want to build a simple game.
work.chat.ex3: Help me decide what features my app needs.
work.chat.ex4: Can you explain what's wrong with this code?
work.chat.end: You can discuss ideas freely. Normal chat does not change your project files.
work.plan.sub: Let AI work out how to do it.
work.plan.d: AI looks at your project, understands your request and creates a list of tasks. You can read the plan and check whether it matches what you want. The actual work starts only after you approve the plan.
work.build.sub: Let AI turn your idea into a real product.
work.build.d: After you approve the plan, OMP starts working on your computer. It can write code, change files and use the tools needed for development. You stay in control of important actions and permissions.
work.review.d: You can see which files have been changed and review the work. If everything looks right, accept the changes. If not, you can restore an earlier version.
work.note: Review is the checking step inside Build. It is not a separate AI system.
path.title: From Ideas to Products. From Products to Market.
path.lead: PCB is about more than writing code.
path.lead2: Our goal is to help people move from an idea to a finished product, and eventually show it, share it and sell it.
journey.chat.d: Tell AI what you want to make. Discuss your ideas and explore different ways to build them.
journey.plan.d: AI studies your request and your project, then creates a step-by-step plan. You can check the plan before work begins.
journey.build.d: AI writes code and changes files on your computer, helping you turn your idea into working software.
journey.promote.d: Help you introduce your product, explain how you built it, make feature demos and create introduction videos. We also plan to connect PCB to social media and other product-sharing platforms.
journey.monetize.d: Add payment and sales features so users can sell their software, digital products and AI products.
path.note: The first three stages are available today. Promote and Monetize are planned for the future.
road.title: Help More People Discover What You Build.
road.lead: PCB aims to help you do more than make software. We also want to help you show it, share it and sell it.
road.demo.d: We plan to turn our experience of building real products with PCB and OMP into a special AI tool.
road.demo.i1: Organise your product idea and features.
road.demo.i2: Explain how your product was built.
road.demo.i3: Make videos showing how the product works.
road.demo.goal: Our goal: Make it easy for everyone to show what they have created.
road.social.d: We plan to help you prepare product introductions and demo videos for sharing online.
road.social.d2: Over time, PCB will connect to supported social media and product-sharing platforms.
road.social.goal: Our goal: Help more people discover the products you build.
road.pay.d: We plan to add payment, purchasing and product delivery features.
road.pay.d2: These features will help users sell their own software, digital products and AI products.
road.pay.goal: Our goal: Help your ideas become products that can also earn money.
road.note: All three features are planned for the future. None is available today.

faq.title: Questions About PCB
faq.a1: PCB is an AI coding tool that runs on your own computer.
faq.a1b: Even if you don't know how to code, you can tell AI what you want to make using everyday language. PCB helps you discuss ideas, make plans and let AI do the actual development work on your computer.
faq.q2: How does PCB work with Oh My Pi (OMP)?
faq.a2.i1: OMP is the AI engine. It understands your requests, makes plans and works with code.
faq.a2.i2: PCB is the app you use to control and check that work.
faq.a2b: OMP does the AI work. PCB makes the process easier to use.
faq.q3: Do I need VS Code or Cursor?
faq.a3b: PCB can work on its own.
faq.a3c: If you want to do more advanced coding later, you can also open VS Code or Cursor if they are already installed on your computer.
faq.q4: Will AI change my files automatically?
faq.a4: Normal chat does not change your project files.
faq.a4b: Before actual development starts, you need to check and approve the AI's plan. Some actions also require extra permission.
faq.q5: What if AI makes a mistake?
faq.a5: You can check the files that AI has changed.
faq.a5b: For important projects, we recommend using Git or another version control tool. This lets you save earlier versions and return to them if something goes wrong.
faq.q6: Does the PCB website upload my project?
faq.a6: No. The PCB website does not store or run your project. Project files are handled on your own computer.
faq.a6b: However, when you use an AI model, some project information needed for the task may be sent to the AI service provider. This depends on the model and settings you choose.
faq.q7: Can I promote my product or receive payments through PCB today?
faq.a7b: Product demos, social media publishing and payment features are planned for the future. They are not available today.
faq.q8: How can I report a problem?
faq.a8: You can report problems on GitHub.
faq.a8.i1: Which version of PCB you are using.
faq.a8.note: Please do not share API keys, passwords or other private information.
about.title: PCB — From Ideas to Products.
about.p1: PCB is an open-source AI tool for building products on your own computer.
about.p2: We want to help more people create their own software with AI, even if they have never written code before.
about.p3: Start with a conversation. Make a plan. Build your product. And, in the future, show it, share it and sell it.
about.line: Your ideas can become real products.
